test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following figures can be formed on folding the given open cube in the question?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29dbf57c9e3a3e0db218c235ab13c7bd3b4ecc14e6ce709504a5b98996c40101.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/360514c25630f2b1d4fd14887a855fa62519529dde98024283bd661a59c0da5a.png] 

M and O is the opposite sides.

P and R is the opposite sides.

N and Q is the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be the adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shows in a dice.

Now,

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c59751baf7233fac597e6b44e664dff60456c5dce0444f730802dbb9c17092d.png] → Can not be made, because N and Q is the opposite sides.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc550b73edb5c2e9fba1e6debfbb7fe7dbdca721871e9935a16bf919859071f5.png] → Can not be made, because M and O is the opposite sides.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5f589b15eb4a86bbbb9b72094b71aedb2381f7283ae4a414b361954a8a0449a.png] → Can not be made, because N and Q is the opposite sides

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b0af71f825f7678149f4f494e590db3187ed5cdcc56ed8dc00d636ec90df684.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
